themes_detail.label: Animal Abuse Complaints Surge
themes_detail.summary: Animal abuse complaints spiked to 17 THIS WEEK—a 268% increase vs. the 8-week average of 4.6 per week (z-score: 4.86)—signaling either a genuine animal welfare crisis or a sudden shift in reporting behavior in Morrisania/Crotona.
evidence: 17 animal abuse complaints filed THIS WEEK vs. 4.6 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
High-severity classification indicates NYPD/Animal Control is treating as urgent
reporting_angles: Interview ASPCA and NYC Animal Care & Control about what's driving the spike—are specific locations or individuals involved?
Canvass residents in high-complaint areas to understand what incidents they've witnessed

themes_detail.label: Food Safety Violations Spike
themes_detail.summary: Food establishment complaints nearly doubled THIS WEEK to 3 complaints vs. a 1.4 weekly average over 8 weeks—a 118% increase (z-score: 3.36)—suggesting possible coordinated violations or inspection sweep in the district.
evidence: 3 food establishment complaints THIS WEEK vs. 1.4 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
High-severity classification suggests DOHMH enforcement action or serious violations
reporting_angles: Check DOH inspection records for recent violations or closures in the district
Interview Health Department about what triggered increased enforcement or complaints

themes_detail.label: Plumbing Infrastructure Deterioration
themes_detail.summary: Plumbing complaints rose to 62 THIS WEEK—a 44% increase vs. the 43-complaint weekly average over 8 weeks (z-score: 3.16)—pointing to possible water system stress or aging pipes failing across the district.
evidence: 62 plumbing complaints THIS WEEK vs. 43 weekly average over prior 8 weeks
Correlates with heat/hot water complaints (1,777 over 90 days), suggesting systemic building infrastructure issues
reporting_angles: Cross-reference plumbing complaints with heat/hot water complaints by address—are the same buildings failing?
Interview DEP about aging water infrastructure in Morrisania/Crotona; check CB budget requests (ongoing DEP capital request)

themes_detail.label: Panhandling and Park Rules Violations
themes_detail.summary: Panhandling complaints spiked 256% to 4 LAST WEEK vs. a 1.1 weekly average (z-score: 3.1), and park rules violations surged 433% to 4 complaints TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 0.8 average—suggesting encampments, loitering, or enforcement crackdowns in public spaces.
evidence: Panhandling: 4 complaints LAST WEEK vs. 1.1 weekly average (256% spike, z-score: 3.1)
Park rules violations: 4 complaints TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 0.8 weekly average (433% spike, z-score: 3.92)
Convergence of two public-space quality-of-life metrics suggests coordinated or concentrated activity
reporting_angles: Visit parks in the district (Crotona Park, etc.) to observe encampments or unusual activity
Interview NYPD about enforcement activity; check if Parks Enforcement Patrol ramped up patrols

themes_detail.label: Real Estate Enforcement Action
themes_detail.summary: Real estate enforcement complaints exploded 967% to 4 complaints TWO WEEKS AGO vs. a 0.4 weekly average (z-score: 7.49, highest severity)—the single strongest statistical anomaly in the data, likely indicating illegal conversions, unlicensed rentals, or code enforcement sweep.
evidence: 4 real estate enforcement complaints TWO WEEKS AGO vs. 0.4 weekly average—967% spike
z-score of 7.49 (highest severity rating in dataset; only complaint type with z-score above 7)
295 building permits filed in 90 days (205 alterations); 1014 Brook Avenue rezoning active—suggests active development/code enforcement environment
reporting_angles: FOIL DOB enforcement records for illegal conversions or landlord violations filed in the last 2 weeks
Interview HPD about enforcement priorities; check if anti-illegal-conversion task force is active in the district
Cross-reference with alteration permits to see if complaints are tied to unfinished or unpermitted work
